text: Download saguaro records GBIF, fit default ensemble 2022 records, test 2023 records, map suitability: generate_map() writes one GeoTIFF per model plus ensemble. Maps download straight Earth Engine tiles; map Earth Engine compute way goes batch system Google Drive instead, slower.
code: library(AlphaSDM)  gbif_records <- function(year) {   url <- paste0("https://api.gbif.org/v1/occurrence/search?",                 "scientificName=Carnegiea%20gigantea&year=", year,                 "&hasCoordinate=true&hasGeospatialIssue=false",                 "&coordinateUncertaintyInMeters=0,30",                 "&decimalLongitude=-111.4,-110.6&decimalLatitude=31.9,32.6&limit=300")   do.call(rbind, lapply(c(0, 300), function(offset)     jsonlite::fromJSON(paste0(url, "&offset=", offset))$results[       , c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude", "year")])) } coords <- c("decimalLongitude", "decimalLatitude")  # Fit on 2022 records with pseudo-absences pres <- format_data(gbif_records(2022), coords = coords, year = "year") occ  <- generate_pseudo_absences(pres, aoi = "bbox", strategy = "combined",                                  n = nrow(pres))  # Test on 2023 records against random background pres_2023 <- format_data(gbif_records(2023), coords = coords, year = "year") test <- generate_pseudo_absences(pres_2023, aoi = "bbox", strategy = "random",                                  n = 2000) fit  <- evaluate_models(occ, predict_coords = test) fit$metrics$ensemble  maps <- generate_map(occ, aoi = "bbox", scale = 30,                      output_dir = "saguaro")

title: Evaluate SDM models on Alpha Earth embeddings — evaluate_models
text: data Data frame training records `longitude`, `latitude`, `year` `present` column (1 = presence; include 0 rows supply real absences). predict_coords Data frame records score, `longitude`, `latitude` `year` ([format_data()]). Include `present` column compute evaluation metrics. scale Embedding resolution metres (default 10, native resolution). methods Character vector models ensemble. Defaults `c("svm", "rf", "gbt")`; also accepts `maxent`, `glm` (logistic regression fitted server-side IRLS equal total class weights), `similarity`, `knn`, `cart`, `mindist`. MaxEnt glm follow regression-family recipe Barbet-Massin et al. (2012): large RANDOM pseudo-absence set suits best (see `?generate_pseudo_absences`). bg_ratio Absence--presence ratio models train balanced pool (rf, gbt knn): absences thinned random `bg_ratio` times number presences. Default 1. `NULL` gives every absence. svm maxent always use every absence. bg_replicates Logical (default TRUE). Train balanced-pool methods (rf, gbt, knn) k = min(10, ceil(10000/pool size)) replicate thinned subsets absences average predictions (Barbet-Massin et al. 2012, Table 1: several runs pseudo-absences used). Requires `bg_ratio` thinning active; methods full pool never replicated. params Named list settings individual models, using argument names Earth Engine classifier, example `list(gbt = list(shrinkage = 0.01), svm = list(kernelType = "RBF"))`. Every model uses Earth Engine's defaults except Earth Engine needs value default work data: `rf` uses 500 trees `gbt` 150, since Earth Engine requires number, `knn` uses 15 neighbours, since Earth Engine's single neighbour gives two-value map. See Earth Engine reference `ee.Classifier.smileRandomForest`, `smileGradientTreeBoost`, `libsvm`, `amnhMaxent`, `smileKNN` `smileCart` every available setting. gee_project Optional Earth Engine project override (normally set via [setup_gee()]).

title: Generate pseudo-absences for presence-only data — generate_pseudo_absences
text: data frame `longitude`, `latitude`, `year`, `present`   (presences 1, pseudo-absences 0), ready   [evaluate_models()] [generate_map()] directly, carrying   settings used `attr(, "pa_settings")`.

title: Generate pseudo-absences for presence-only data — generate_pseudo_absences

title: AlphaSDM 0.2.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-10-04 First CRAN release. Model settings now given per model params, using Earth Engine’s argument names, example params = list(gbt = list(shrinkage = 0.01)). replaces separate arguments n_trees, shrinkage, svm_cost, knn_k rest, applied several models silently override values equal defaults. Misspelt settings now error. Every model uses Earth Engine’s defaults, except tree counts Earth Engine requires (rf 500, gbt 150) knn, uses 15 neighbours Earth Engine’s single neighbour gives two-value map. SVM now Earth Engine’s default linear classifier, boosted trees use Earth Engine’s learning rate, gives better-calibrated probabilities. Fixed classification SVMs (C_SVC, NU_SVC) returning inverted scores. probability depended order training rows, Earth Engine preserve; training table now sorted fitting. generate_pseudo_absences() now reads pseudo-absences years presences, proportions, instead latest embedding year. Pass aoi_year place one year. Models trained rows fixed order, retraining (Earth Engine every map tile) gives model. Random forests now exactly reproducible; boosted trees vary 0.005 inside Earth Engine. Simpler arguments: balance_trees gone (use bg_ratio, default 1, NULL every absence), persist_classifier, async options evaluate_models(), now requires predict_coords year column. generate_map() maps records’ common year default. sdm_gee_status() now gee_tasks() sdm_clean_assets() gee_clean_assets(). sdm_verbose() exported calculate_cbi() gone: use suppressMessages(), cbi calculate_classifier_metrics(). Removed naive Bayes, discards negative values use signed embeddings. vignette now tests models following year’s records. Maps download straight Earth Engine tiles sized 32 MB download limit, fetched two time stitched one GeoTIFF per model. Google Drive used maps Earth Engine compute tile tile. generate_map() computes ensemble Earth Engine accepts aoi = "bbox". Earth Engine Python client declared reticulate::py_require(), reticulate installs needed; AlphaSDM longer installs Python longer depends ‘rgee’. saved project ID lives tools::R_user_dir("AlphaSDM", "config"). clear_gee_credentials() removes asks signing Earth Engine. Connecting Earth Engine longer deletes old temporary assets; use gee_clean_assets(). getting-started vignette, vignette("AlphaSDM"), maps saguaro around Tucson GBIF records. Removed unused code, including remains built-cross-validation.
